en.title: South Africa v Australia: first men's cricket Test, day four – as it happened
en.summary: Australia moved closer to victory in the Test match against South Africa with strong performances from their batsmen. Matt Renshaw continued his impressive form as Australia progressed with the bat while requiring six more wickets for victory.

en.title: Federal agents search Ilhan Omar's home as part of criminal investigation
en.summary: Law enforcement agents searched Representative Ilhan Omar's residence as part of a criminal investigation, according to the Department of Justice. The search follows accusations from political figures regarding immigration-related matters.

en.title: Duel in the desert: US marine veteran aims to win back working-class voters for Democrats
en.summary: Tucson mayor Regina Romero, a marine veteran, is campaigning in Arizona to support Democrat JoAnna Mendoza's bid to unseat Republican congressman Juan Ciscomani in a swing district. Romero's background is being leveraged to connect with working-class voters.

stories.title: Michael Jordan Last Dance jersey bought for record $14m in private sale

en.title: Michael Jordan Last Dance jersey bought for record $14m in private sale
en.summary: A jersey worn by Michael Jordan during the 1998 NBA finals sold for $14 million in a private sale, setting a record for basketball memorabilia. The Chicago Bulls defeated the Utah Jazz in the game where Jordan wore the jersey.
